# ScholarshipTop
# https://scholarshiptop.com/llms.txt

> ScholarshipTop is a scholarship search and application workspace for international students. It organizes scholarship details, eligibility signals, deadlines, award information, provider application paths, shortlisting tools, and AI support so students can move faster toward application.

## Identity

- Site: https://scholarshiptop.com/
- Product type: Scholarship search, comparison, shortlisting, and application-planning workspace
- Core value: organized scholarship details, smart filters, eligibility signals, deadlines, award context, provider application paths, and AI application support

## Languages and URLs

- **English (canonical):** Site root — no `/en` prefix. Do not use or cite `https://scholarshiptop.com/en`.
- **Spanish:** https://scholarshiptop.com/es/
- **French:** https://scholarshiptop.com/fr/

ES and FR database-backed translations are rolled out gradually. Only published, quality-gated localized pages exist; missing translations may return **404**. Do not assume every English URL has a Spanish or French equivalent.

## Core public areas (English at root)

- Scholarships: https://scholarshiptop.com/scholarships
- Providers: https://scholarshiptop.com/providers
- Resources (guides): https://scholarshiptop.com/resources
- Essay guides: https://scholarshiptop.com/essays
- Compare: https://scholarshiptop.com/compare
- How it works: https://scholarshiptop.com/how-scholarshiptop-works

## Scholarship IQ (separate product)

Assessment and guidance product on a dedicated subdomain:

- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/es
- https://iq.scholarshiptop.com/fr

IQ is an assessment and guidance product, not a scholarship awarding authority.

## Boundaries

- ScholarshipTop helps students discover, compare, shortlist, and prepare for scholarships.
- Final selection decisions and award disbursement are made by the relevant scholarship provider.
- Provider application paths are included when available so students can continue toward submission from organized ScholarshipTop context.
- ScholarshipTop content is not legal, immigration, tax, or financial aid advice.
